other_conditions: Applicant must have a disability of 40% or more
Applicant must possess a Disability Certificate or a UDID Card
Applicant must be a member of a BPL family or have a recommendation from the Collector or Sub‑Divisional Officer (Revenue)
Monthly income of the applicant’s parents/guardian should be less than ₹8,000
benefits_summary: Provides artificial limbs/assistive devices worth up to ₹6,900 to eligible persons with disabilities.
